name: @pointly/infrastructure
description: Pointly AWS infrastructure managed with Terraform

scripts.tf:plan:dev: cd terraform && terraform workspace select dev || terraform workspace new dev && terraform plan -var-file=environments/dev.tfvars
scripts.tf:plan:prod: cd terraform && terraform workspace select prod || terraform workspace new prod && terraform plan -var-file=environments/prod.tfvars
scripts.tf:apply:dev: cd terraform && terraform workspace select dev && terraform apply -var-file=environments/dev.tfvars
scripts.tf:apply:prod: cd terraform && terraform workspace select prod && terraform apply -var-file=environments/prod.tfvars
